entries.german:
Lehenrevers Hansens von Rosenberg an H. Graf Johann zu Wertheim ausgestellet über den halben Teil zu Hirschlanden im Dorf und in Feld mit allen seinen Rechten Zu- und Eingehörungen, welches Mannlehen Conrad von Rosenberg, sein Vetter, von Cuntzen von Rosenberg zu Bartenstein gekauft hat.

Laufzeit: 1428 Juni 13 (an sanct Antoni)
entries.english:
Hans von Rosenberg's feudal acknowledgment, issued to Lord Count Johann zu Wertheim, concerning one half of the property at Hirschlanden, in the village and its fields, with all its rights, appurtenances, and accessories. This fief held by male-line heirs had been purchased by Konrad von Rosenberg, his cousin, from Kunz von Rosenberg zu Bartenstein.

Term: 13 June 1428 (on Saint Anthony's day).
